indicators.title: Missing HSTS Header
indicators.description: Strict-Transport-Security header is not present. Browsers will not strictly enforce HTTPS, allowing potential SSL-stripping man-in-the-middle attacks.
indicators.remediation: Add 'Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload' to server responses.

indicators.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy (CSP)
indicators.description: Content-Security-Policy header is missing. CSP prevents Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and data injection by specifying permitted sources for scripts and styles.
indicators.remediation: Implement a robust Content-Security-Policy header defining trusted sources for scripts, styles, and frames.

indicators.title: Missing Clickjacking Protection
indicators.description: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors is configured. The page can be embedded in an iframe on third-party sites, exposing users to clickjacking.
indicators.remediation: Add 'X-Frame-Options: DENY' or 'X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN', or use CSP 'frame-ancestors 'self''.' to prevent unauthorized framing.

indicators.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
indicators.description: X-Content-Type-Options is missing or not set to 'nosniff'. Browsers may attempt to MIME-sniff response content, potentially executing untrusted scripts.
indicators.remediation: Add 'X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff' header to all HTTP responses.

indicators.title: Missing Referrer-Policy
indicators.description: Referrer-Policy header is not set. Browsers may leak full URLs and sensitive path/query parameters in Referer headers when navigating to external origins.

indicators.title: Server Version Disclosed
indicators.description: Server header exposes specific version details: "nginx/1.29.8". Version disclosure simplifies targeted exploit research for attackers.
indicators.remediation: Suppress or generalize the Server header in web server configuration (e.g. 'Server: webserver').
